agent_manager_daily_audit.definition: Roles are audit-attributed code paths and PC/NB scheduled jobs; NOT nine persistent independent LLM agents.

roles.label: Promoter / Planner
roles.assessment: Blocked adapters are implementation backlog, not a Promoter malfunction.

roles.label: Native MT5 Executor
roles.reliability_basis: native fresh-evidence success per attempted tester phase
roles.assessment: Technical reliability is separate from strategy profitability. Fresh native FIT/VAL hashes are the pass criteria.

roles.label: Judge / Red Team
roles.assessment: Rejecting a weak strategy is a correct Judge action, not a task failure. Historical validation is reused and not blind OOS.

roles.label: Scorekeeper / Evidence
roles.assessment: Integrity measures native report evidence, not trading returns or causal value of the strategy.

roles.label: Discovery Manager
roles.reliability_basis: discovered case records persisted (not EA eligibility)
roles.assessment: Discovery volume is not value. Monitor duplicates, EA readiness and how many exact cases later get native evidence.

roles.label: External Research Radar
roles.reliability_basis: public source candidates recorded; source quality not yet independently verified
roles.assessment: External sources are untrusted research leads, not downloaded strategies, verified edges or executable jobs.

roles.label: Qwen3 Hypothesis Generator
roles.reliability_basis: hypotheses written to PC ledger, not validated correctness
roles.assessment: Generating a hypothesis is not evidence of correctness. Qwen remains SHADOW.

roles.label: Independent ChatGPT Reviewer
roles.reliability_basis: structured verdict records received (not AI truth accuracy)
roles.assessment: ChatGPT plausibility review is not a substitute for fresh MT5 OOS tests or human promotion.

roles.label: Web / Report Publisher
roles.reliability_basis: PC telemetry checkpoint events only; GitHub Pages deploys NOT counted
roles.assessment: A PC checkpoint event does not verify GitHub Actions deployment or page freshness; check separately.

logic.long: Fast EMA crosses above Slow EMA on completed candle; prior fast ≤ prior slow
logic.short: Fast EMA crosses below Slow EMA on completed candle; prior fast ≥ prior slow
logic.exit: Close existing owned position on an opposite nonzero signal, then reverse if price/ATR checks pass; broker SL / TP may exit earlier
logic.stacking: One EA-controlled position; fixed 0.10 lot in current MultiFamily tester EA
logic.risk: SL distance = max(broker min distance, InpATRStop × ATR(14)); TP disabled when InpATRTarget=0
logic.signal_timing: Signals use completed bars (shift 1 and 2), then execute at new candle on GOLDmicro H1
logic.note: Only parameters in parameters_used affect the indicator entry. Other generic parameter fields may be recorded but unused.
